title: Sound Exchange
blurb: Press a playlist into a battle creature. The title shapes its body; every song adds a part, stats and a move named after the song. Creatures brawl on their own in 3D, shouting their moves like comic sound effects. Fill your hype, hit S, and tap to the beat for a special.
controls: Type an artist or song and pick a suggestion (or tap a sample), then press. Battles play out on their own. When hype hits 100, press S (or the S key), then tap the screen (or Space) on every beat. The 3D button toggles 3D; drag the 3D card model to spin it.
